_comment: ARM 34 — SPEC_level_information_budget §17 item 1, STAGE 1, re-run on the CURRENT
mask denominator.  LV-4 alone (network.rx_cb_carry_step_gate); de-mean OFF, so the
loader forces LV-5 off (GnssConfigLoadNetwork.cpp:6630) and the LV-5 machinery sits
idle — exactly the posture §17 item 1 names.  LV-1 (iono_seed_field_frame) OFF.
WHY THIS RUNS AT ALL, given §19 closed item 1 FALSIFIED.  §19 graded
_ext63_gps_dual_1h_lv45.json against the 10/25 canonical.  §20.3 then changed the
masks and §21 measured what that costs: the LEVEL is worth ~5-6 TECU to the
OBSERVATION mask and the RESIDUAL is worth +27..46 % to the IONO cutoff.  §21's own
closing warning is that arm 31 or 32 becomes the new denominator and that NOTHING in
§9-§20 survives the change.  §19 is in §9-§20.  Both of §19's stage-1 verdicts are
therefore measured against a voided control, and one of them — the sh_health FAIL —
is on the axis the mask change moves MOST:
§19 FAIL:  LV-4 alone parks a00 at 2.69 TECU settled (min -0.76), out of the
[2, 150] band for 46 of 121 epochs => 46 emissions withheld.
§21:       obs mask 10 -> 15 is worth +5..6 TECU of level, at either iono cutoff.
A knob that fails a band test by ~2 TECU, on an axis a since-landed mask change moves
by 5-6 TECU in the helpful direction, has not been tested — it has been tested at the
wrong operating point.  This arm retests it at the right one.
CONTROL: arm 32, runs/ext63_dual_3h_m15i25 (obs 15 / iono 25), same build, same
lineage, same window, ONE knob apart (rx_cb_carry_step_gate).  Its first hour is the
matched 1 h control; no separate canonical run is needed.  Measured on it, settled
median postfit phase rms   0.00800 m over 4935 STA rows / 78931 phase obs
a00 settled                24.27 +- 2.56 TECU, min 19.11, max 29.01
sh_health                  0 / 0 / 0
rx-CB carry fold rate      9697 folded / 21888 (44.3 %) over 3 h
NOTE the identical-observations control is RESTORED inside this pair: both arms run
obs mask 15, so the ~10 % obs-count gap that §21 had to caveat (10 vs 15 masks) is
absent here.  §19's 10/25 pair had it too (88993 phase obs); this pair should sit at
arm 32's ~78931.  Any large deviation means a second variable is loose.
PREDICTIONS, STATED BEFORE THE RUN (§17 stage-1 gate + the §19.6 invariant-legal
grade, which §17's original gate list predates and which is the one that matters):
1. DATA SIDE — FAIL, and this is the real verdict.  §19.3 attributes +64 % postfit
phase rms to LV-4 and to LV-4 alone (0.01020 -> 0.01670 at 10/25; every LV-4-
bearing arm at 0.0166-0.0167, every arm without it at 0.0100-0.0102).  That is an
arm-to-arm A/B at FIXED masks over identical observations, and the mechanism —
full admission delivers carry information the observations do not support — has
no mask dependence.  So predict 0.0125-0.0135 m here, i.e. ~+60 % over arm 32's
0.00800.  Residuals are datum-INVARIANT (§19.6), so this is a legal GRADE.
2. LEVEL / sh_health — PASS, i.e. §19's stated failure criterion FLIPS.  LV-4 alone
moved the level -14.76 TECU at 10/25 (17.45 -> 2.69).  Applying the same offset to
arm 32's 24.27 gives ~9.5 TECU settled with min ~6 — comfortably inside [2, 150].
Predict sh_health 0/0/0 and zero withheld emissions.  Under invariant #5 this is a
DIAGNOSTIC, not a grade (a00 is a frame quantity, §17 item 0 / §19.6) — but the
46 withheld emissions WERE a real operational failure, so removing them removes
§19's stated stage-1 FAIL and the item cannot be closed on that ground again.
3. MECHANICS — unchanged from §19.1: folds ~97.5 %, erases ~1.7 %, settled sd <= 5,
no ~3-epoch alternation.  These passed at 10/25 and are not mask-sensitive.
If 1 and 2 both land, the honest reading is that item 1 fails on the DATA side and
not on the band, §19's conclusion survives but its published REASON does not, and the
item closes on an invariant-legal grade instead of a frame quantity.  If 1 MISSES —
if LV-4's data-side cost is small at obs mask 15 — then §19's attribution was itself a
mask artifact, item 1 is LIVE, and stage 2 (3 h) is earned.
STAGE GATE (§17 item 1, escalate 1 h -> 3 h -> 12 h, fresh SEAMLESS lineage each
stage, next stage ONLY on the previous gate passing — user directive 2026-08-05):
folds >= 95 %, erases <= 2 %, settled sd <= 5 TECU, no ~3-epoch alternation,
sh_health 0/0/0, AND (added here, §19.6) settled median rms_phase within ~5 % of
the matched control's 0.00800 m.  1 h is a STABILITY gate, NOT a level grade —
§14: 1 h is inside the ~2 h convergence budget of the level channel.
§13.5 AUDIT FEEDS are armed from this FIRST stage per §17 item 1 — inherited from
_ft63_24h_conv.json (trace_postfit_sigma0, trace_postfit_keyed) and
_golden63_gps_1h_laneoff.json (prior_residual_families 'pl,pb,cb,zwd,rxcb'), and
restated here so the arm is self-documenting.  KNOWN instrument holes (§19.4,
verified): network_prior_residual.csv emits ONLY the rxcb family under this posture,
and network_pf_keyed.csv has n_code == 0 in every row, so s0_code / rms_code are
identically zero and any code-side read is vacuous.  Usable data-side instruments
here: rms_phase / s0_phase from pf_keyed, and congruence sigma0.  Block-Baarda is
floored at sigma0 = 1.0 for 100 % of a 1 h settled window — do NOT read it at 1 h.
FRESH LINEAGE, own paths; never resume onto another arm's snapshot.
